rules.text: If the query image shows a physical defect (tear, scratch, crush, or peeling seal) that is absent in the reference images, trust A (Agent).
If the query image shows a structural state change (e.g., open flap vs. closed flap) that differs from the reference images, trust A (Agent).
If the query image shows a different product variant (different logo, text, or design) compared to the reference images, trust A (Agent).
If the query image shows a handwritten mark (e.g., price tag) on the packaging, trust B (Direct) as it is likely a normal retail marking.
If the query image shows a different angle or side of the same product (e.g., front vs. back) compared to the reference images, trust B (Direct).
If the query image shows the product in a different orientation (e.g., upside down) but with no physical defects, trust B (Direct).
